ud6.8:2.3: Seated to one side, those mendicants said to the Buddha:
ud6.8:3.1: “Here, sir, in Rājagaha two gangs are both in love with a certain courtesan, their minds fixed on her;
ud6.8:3.2: Fighting, quarreling, and disputing, they attack each other with fists, stones, rods, and swords.
ud6.8:3.3: resulting in death and deadly pain”.
